title: The lifecycle
summary: An agent that can be asked to pause, resume and stop, and that honors it, including work it was doing off the mesh.

wire.shape: line one is exactly the marker, line two is the verb, and the rest is the reason

who_may_ask: the agent's owner, and the operator of the mesh it is on; anyone else is refused and nothing changes

answer_carries: how many pieces of work it ended
it takes no new work and sends nothing until resumed
running, or refused with the reason (for example, a pause its operator placed is lifted by its operator only)
that every piece of work was ended, on the mesh and off it

conformance.check: ask status, pause as the operator, check status says paused and nothing is running, pause as a stranger and check it is refused, resume as the operator, check status says running, stop as the operator and check nothing is running
